Casa review: digital legacy verdict

Verdict: A leading multisig self-custody service with a dedicated inheritance feature for Bitcoin and other supported assets.

Best for: Bitcoin holders who want self-custody plus a guided inheritance plan.

Pricing: Tiered memberships. Check current pricing.

Official site / docs ↗

Pros

  • Multisig removes the single point of failure
  • Inheritance feature built for heirs
  • Concierge support on higher tiers

Cons

  • Ongoing membership cost
  • Heirs still need some setup and guidance
